'''House Baliss''' was the second estate of [[House Baliss]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] and vassals of [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the House Baliss remained neutral when the [[Alderaan Civil War]] broke out, but their original estate was overrun by the native [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and abandoned. [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Yun Baliss]] conquered the estate of the [[House Teraan]] after House Baliss was forced to retreat there, making their estate the family's new home.
